font.notes: Covers Arabic and Latin, so mixed Arabic/Latin lines share one design. Never reference system-only faces (SF Arabic, Geeza Pro): headless Chrome cannot load them.

readability_policy.subtitle: Intentional caption-specific exception: timed subtitles/captions may use a lower phone-scale floor (landscape 8px, portrait 12px) than general secondary UI text (10px / 14px). This applies ONLY to the `subtitle` role (class `subtitle`) on timed subtitle elements. It is NOT a global readability relaxation: headline, labels, statistics, cards, and all other secondary UI text keep the existing secondary floor. Rationale: subtitles are read in sync with narration and are transcribed speech, not standalone UI copy, so their legibility requirement differs from body/UI text.

frame_zero.notes: Content coverage = share of pixels that differ from the dominant background luma by more than 32/255. Calibrated on existing renders: legacy hooks measure 0.0 at frame 0 and about 0.005 at 0.5s; a readable hook headline measures about 0.027.
